input.quote: For a renewable one-year term commencing upon the Maintenance Commencement Date, subject to payment of maintenance fees in accordance with the Fee Schedule but without additional fees or charges, Garman shall provide the following Maintenance Services:
input.rationale: There is no automatic renewal mechanic anywhere in the Agreement. Maintenance runs for "a renewable one-year term" (p0065), i.e. a 12-month term that can only be extended by the parties' affirmative agreement, and the licence itself is perpetual so long as fees are paid (p0117). Sparkling may in any event terminate at will on 90 days' notice (p0118), so there is no non-renewal notice window to compute and no risk of lock-in or multi-year auto-renewal. This meets the preferred position (renewal by mutual agreement, 12-month term, easy exit). Two sub-elements fall short of the ideal drafting but are not material deviations: there is no express cap on renewal-period maintenance fee uplift (fees are simply "in accordance with the Fee Schedule"), and no vendor reminder mechanic — we would raise the CPI/3% uplift cap in the Fee Schedule negotiation rather than by redline here.
